offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures steering and driveline systems for passenger and commercial vehicle manufacturers. It develops hardware and embedded controls for vehicle programs and supplies the systems directly to automakers.

primary_products.value: Electric power steering and steer-by-wire systems; hydraulic power steering systems; steering columns; intermediate steering shafts; driveline half-shafts

customer_segment.value: B2B: Passenger and commercial vehicle manufacturers

revenue_model.value: product sales: Steering and driveline systems supplied under automaker production agreements

value_chain_position.value: component supplier: Integrates mechanical parts, electronics and embedded controls into systems supplied directly to automakers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia, with manufacturing in Morocco

specialization.value: related lines: Steering systems, steering columns and shafts, driveline components and embedded motion-control software

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Automaker purchasing and engineering teams for vehicle production programs

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Steering systems are subject to vehicle safety requirements, including UNECE steering rules where applicable
